retraction.reason: Retracted in M41b: the Partido Liberal Social, accepted by the Constitutional Court on 11 March 2025. It is two months older than the most recent record in this atlas and has done nothing yet that any source describes. Retracted for want of anything at all to say, not for want of importance.
